name: NGC 4710 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4710, an edge-on lenticular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4710-hubble
story: Seen edge-on, this lenticular galaxy shows a boxy, peanut-shaped bulge, and a faint, ethereal X-shaped structure hides at its center.

claims.text: NGC 4710 is a lenticular or S0-type galaxy
It has a boxy or peanut-shaped bulge, evident edge-on
A faint, ethereal X-shaped structure is seen at the center
